source.turns: Han asked the agent to work through the Worth-exploring items of two architecture reviews and present its decisions with to-decision-html (2026-11-13).

source.title: Episode Spec page, from template to approval
source.turns: Han approved after four feedback rounds (2026-11-14), then asked: "can you also save the current version as an eval baseline?"
source.copy: decisions.md is the sample Episode's Brief (skills/new-episode/assets/sample-episode/brief.md), then its Title slide and four Slides with purpose, words from the sample Dossier and every Option from skills/new-episode/assets/sample-fragments/fragments.html: caption, build notes and mock HTML verbatim. visual-language.html and episode-page.html are those fragments byte for byte. design.css is the page's compiled <style data-design-css> block byte for byte, so a run can inline the tokens the mocks use. calibration.md holds caller facts only, drawn from skills/new-episode/references/spec-calibration.md: mode, audience, items, fidelity, design size, render presets, tokens, Next actions and feedback fields. It states none of the page's layout rules, so the skill must produce them itself. rounds.md quotes Han's words from the four rounds; checklist.json cites it. prompt.md asks the task as a caller would, without the word template.
source.omitted: The Spec template (skills/new-episode/assets/spec-template.html, provenance only), the assembler and the review server; the four fix-round briefs, except the sentences of Han's that rounds.md quotes.
source.reference: reference.html is skills/new-episode/assets/sample-episode/spec/spec.html, approved by Han 2026-11-14 at d3e15b61, refrozen at 75007abe after the final review fixes, which kept the approved look. Round 5 (drafts per revision, read-only locks, one feedback formatter) left its inline design CSS unchanged. It is self-contained: inline CSS and scripts, no link or fetch of another file, so it is frozen byte for byte. Runs never see it.
